claims.claim_text: The loglog chronicles a weekend house-hunting negotiation
claims.evidence_quote: Negotiation Duration: 3 Days (Friday-Sunday)
claims.reasoning: Source centers on Friday-Sunday talks plus prelude and followup; weekend framing is fair compression.

claims.claim_text: The buyer made an asking-price offer that failed
claims.evidence_quote: We send an offer ... at the asking price
claims.reasoning: Friday 6pm asking-price offer was stalled and never accepted; walkaway followed.

claims.claim_text: The buyer made retaliatory price cuts
claims.evidence_quote: I drop the offer by 20K from the asking price
claims.reasoning: Source records a 20K cut Saturday and a 10K-below revision Sunday after the stall.

claims.claim_text: The buyer walked away from the deal
claims.evidence_quote: Final Outcome: Walked away
claims.reasoning: Debrief states walked away; narrative ends with no purchase and refusal of further offers.

claims.claim_text: The piece draws lessons on realtor leverage
claims.evidence_quote: realtors have created this system ... playing with us as pawns
claims.reasoning: Final thoughts and Monday message generalize the weekend into leverage and disclosure lessons.

claims.claim_text: The search ran about a year in a split market, involving N, J, C and L
claims.evidence_quote: looking for a house for almost a year now
claims.reasoning: Duration matches; role key matches N realtor, J seller realtor, C partner, L assistant.

claims.claim_text: Many houses linger very long; some vanish in 1-2 days
claims.evidence_quote: stay for a loooooong time ... gone in usually 1-2 days
claims.reasoning: Rephrase preserves both halves of the market description with numbers intact.

claims.claim_text: N is the buyer agent, J the seller agent, C the partner, L the assistant
claims.evidence_quote: N is my realtor ... J is the seller's realtor ... C is J's partner ... L is J and C's assistant
claims.reasoning: Attributions match exactly; shortening L to assistant is harmless compression.

claims.claim_text: The first Wednesday offer was at the affordability ceiling and failed
claims.evidence_quote: I put the highest price I can afford on a house
claims.reasoning: Wednesday highest-affordable bid followed by Thursday 6pm rejection.

claims.claim_text: That bid sat about 30K below asking
claims.evidence_quote: still about 30K below the asking price
claims.reasoning: Amount and about qualifier preserved exactly.

claims.claim_text: Thursday 6pm rejection; sellers moved on with other offers
claims.evidence_quote: my offer is not accepted and they are moving forward with other offers
claims.reasoning: Time and outcome match the Thursday 6pm row verbatim in meaning.

claims.claim_text: The Friday asking-price bid sought instant acceptance before rivals
claims.evidence_quote: they accept it right away, but I don't give them time for other showings
claims.reasoning: Motive paraphrases the stated no-bidding-war, accept-right-away reasoning.

claims.claim_text: Friday 1pm showing convinced the buyer; a sweet asking-price offer was planned
claims.evidence_quote: We see the house. I like it. I'm going to put an offer at the asking price
claims.reasoning: Time, liking, and asking-price plan all stated in the Friday 1pm row.

claims.claim_text: N advised 10K below to leave negotiation room; buyer unconvinced
claims.evidence_quote: N says to write an offer 10K below and let them negotiate
claims.reasoning: Advice amount matches; buyer pushback recorded in the same row.

claims.claim_text: Friday 6pm offer at asking with sweets, deadline midnight same day
claims.evidence_quote: We send an offer ... at the asking price with the deadline of same day midnight
claims.reasoning: Price, sweeteners, and same-day-midnight deadline all match.

claims.claim_text: Seller side cited busyness, sought extension, mentioned a rival offer
claims.evidence_quote: she is driving up island ... asking us to extend the offer ... another offer on the house
claims.reasoning: All three elements stated in Friday 10:30pm row; [reported] flag preserves attribution.

claims.claim_text: Friday 10:30pm: driving up island; extend to tomorrow midnight; another offer mentioned
claims.evidence_quote: driving up island for a family thing ... extend the offer until tomorrow midnight
claims.reasoning: Time, trip detail, extension target, and rival mention match the source row.

claims.claim_text: Buyer doubted the rival offer and feared bid-war leverage
claims.evidence_quote: I'm not even sure they have another offer ... used for pushing others to put a higher price
claims.reasoning: Thoughts row states disbelief and fear of the offer being used to push price.

claims.claim_text: Friday 11pm counter extended only to 10:30am Saturday
claims.evidence_quote: I extend the offer until 10:30am Saturday
claims.reasoning: Time and shortened extension match exactly.

claims.claim_text: Buyer retaliated with cuts while sellers countered above asking
claims.evidence_quote: I drop the offer by 20K ... counter offer is for 5K above the asking price
claims.reasoning: Both directions documented Saturday 5pm and Saturday 9pm rows.

claims.claim_text: Saturday 5pm: buyer dropped 20K from asking, stripped sweets, defying N
claims.evidence_quote: I drop the offer by 20K ... remove most of those sweet things ... N strongly advises me against
claims.reasoning: Amount, stripped sweeteners, time, and N opposition all match.

claims.claim_text: J was replaced by C on REW, gone from 4 listings; $3.5M showing noted
claims.evidence_quote: name of the seller's realtor J on the REW website is changed to her partner's C ... removed from all her listings (a total of 4) ... busy with showings of a $3.5M house
claims.reasoning: Name swap, 4-listing count, and $3.5M detail all preserved.

claims.claim_text: Saturday 9pm counter 5K above asking with disclosure; reply by 11pm
claims.evidence_quote: counter offer is for 5K above the asking price ... They want a response by 11pm
claims.reasoning: Counter amount, disclosure letter context, and 11pm deadline match.

claims.claim_text: Saturday silence, rare nap as load lifted; N later endorsed the cuts
claims.evidence_quote: super rare for me to take a nap ... big load is taken off ... he thinks I did the right thing
claims.reasoning: Nap rarity and relief reason plus Saturday 9:30pm N endorsement both stated.

claims.claim_text: Sunday email fight ended cooperation; buyer demanded in-person terms
claims.evidence_quote: I will only present my offer in person and would need a response right away
claims.reasoning: L-N exchange plus refusal of further open offers supports the ended-cooperation reading.

claims.claim_text: L called the sub-2-hour Sunday deadline unprofessional; cited 37 years admin experience
claims.evidence_quote: less than 2 hours for the Sellers to respond ... very unprofessional ... over 37 years
claims.reasoning: Turnaround complaint, unprofessional charge, and tenure number match L letters.

claims.claim_text: N replied the Friday full-price stall left unwanted 2nd and 3rd offers
claims.evidence_quote: your team stalled and ended up with a 2nd and 3rd offers your clients are not interested in
claims.reasoning: N rebuttal content matches including the stalled full-price Friday offer.

claims.claim_text: Sunday 8am: 10K below asking, no sweets, 11am deadline; rival ceiling believed 45K-30K below
claims.evidence_quote: update it to 10K below the asking price, remove every single sweet thing ... until 11am ... 45K below ... 30K below
claims.reasoning: Revision terms, deadline, and 45K-30K belief band all match the Sunday 8am row.

claims.claim_text: Buyer refused further open offers; wanted in-person Monday after 5:30
claims.evidence_quote: Likely Monday after 5:30 ... I'm certainly not writing another offer, I will not have an open offer
claims.reasoning: Both the in-person demand with Monday timing and the no-open-offer stance stated.

claims.claim_text: House sold below asking; buyer set disclosure rules
claims.evidence_quote: the house is sold for 10K below ... ask them to provide that in writing in form of the disclosure letter
claims.reasoning: Outcome plus Monday rule change both documented.

claims.claim_text: Two weeks later sold 10K below asking; N owes coffee
claims.evidence_quote: the house is sold for 10K below the asking price ... N is going to buy me a coffee
claims.reasoning: Timing, sale discount, and coffee outcome match exactly.

claims.claim_text: New rule: no volunteered offer talk; written disclosure letters required
claims.evidence_quote: please do not volunteer any information regarding existing or competing offers ... provide that in writing in form of the disclosure letter
claims.reasoning: Monday message rules paraphrased without scope change.

claims.claim_text: Earlier house resisted 5-10% push; sold 5% over bid after 7 months
claims.evidence_quote: pushed me multiple times to go 5-10% more ... sold for 5% more than my price ... it took 7 months
claims.reasoning: Push band, resale premium, and 7-month delay all preserved.

claims.claim_text: Seller trains car dealerships; realtor system plays clients as pawns
claims.evidence_quote: seller is a marketing and sales person who teaches car dealerships how to sell ... playing with us as pawns
claims.reasoning: Seller occupation and pawns metaphor both stated; exaggeration caveat retained in source.

claims.claim_text: Claude debrief: February 2025, 3-day Friday-Sunday talks, walked away
claims.evidence_quote: Date of Experience: February 2025 ... Negotiation Duration: 3 Days (Friday-Sunday) ... Final Outcome: Walked away
claims.reasoning: Date, duration, and outcome match the debrief header; [reported] flag correct.

claims.claim_text: Arc: optimistic start, skeptical middle, detached strategic end
claims.evidence_quote: Cautiously optimistic ... Increasing skepticism ... Emotionally detached, strategic focus
claims.reasoning: Three-stage emotional arc paraphrases the debrief observations.

claims.claim_text: Tactics: disclosure demands, short windows, stripped sweets, no bidding war
claims.evidence_quote: Requested written disclosure ... short-duration offer windows ... Removing favorable conditions ... Avoiding bidding war
claims.reasoning: All four tactics listed in the debrief strategic-moves section.

claims.claim_text: Successes: bluff detection, discipline; failures: no purchase, strained ties
claims.evidence_quote: Successfully identified when competing offers were likely bluffs ... No house purchased ... Created tension
claims.reasoning: Success/failure ledger matches the analysis section summaries.

claims.claim_text: Keep verification; soften timelines and style; add walkaway thresholds
claims.evidence_quote: Information verification requirements ... Timeline flexibility ... walk away price threshold
claims.reasoning: Keep-modify-add recommendations compressed without changing scope.
